sentences.en: peter : Hello?
sentences.zh: peter : 喂？

sentences.en: jan : Oh hello
sentences.zh: jan : 哦，你好。

sentences.en: My name's Jan
sentences.zh: 我的名字是简。

sentences.en: Are you the right person to talk to about the Buckworth Conservation Group?
sentences.zh: 您是负责布克沃思环保小组事务的合适联系人吗？

sentences.en: peter : Yes, I'm Peter
sentences.zh: peter : 是的，我是彼得。

sentences.en: I'm the secretary
sentences.zh: 我担任该小组的秘书。

sentences.en: jan : Good
sentences.zh: jan : 太好了。

sentences.en: I've just moved to this area, and I'm interested in getting involved
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到这个地区，很想参与其中。

sentences.en: I was in a similar group where I used to live
sentences.zh: 我以前住的地方也有一个类似的环保小组。

sentences.en: Could you tell me something about your activities, please?
sentences.zh: 您能向我介绍一下你们开展的活动吗？

sentences.en: peter : Of course
sentences.zh: peter : 当然可以。

sentences.en: Well, we have a mixture of regular activities and special events
sentences.zh: 我们既有常规活动，也有特别活动。

sentences.en: One of the regular ones is trying to keep the beach free of litter
sentences.zh: 其中一项常规活动是努力保持海滩清洁、无垃圾。

sentences.en: A few of us spend a couple of hours a month on it, and it's awful how much there is to clear
sentences.zh: 我们几个人每月花几个小时做这项工作，但要清理的垃圾数量实在令人震惊。

sentences.en: I wish people would be more responsible and take it home with them
sentences.zh: 我希望人们能更有责任感，把垃圾带回家处理。

sentences.en: jan : I totally agree
sentences.zh: jan : 我完全同意。

sentences.en: I'd be happy to help with that
sentences.zh: 我很乐意帮忙做这件事。

sentences.en: Is it OK to take dogs?
sentences.zh: 可以带狗去吗？

sentences.en: peter : I'm afraid not, as they're banned from the beach itself
sentences.zh: peter : 很抱歉，不行，因为海滩本身是禁止携犬进入的。

sentences.en: You can take them along the cliffs, though
sentences.zh: 不过，您可以带狗沿着悬崖散步。

sentences.en: And children are welcome
sentences.zh: 儿童也欢迎参加。

sentences.en: jan : Right
sentences.zh: jan : 明白了。

sentences.en: peter : We also manage a nature reserve, and there's a lot to do there all year round
sentences.zh: peter : 我们还管理着一处自然保护区，全年都有大量工作要做。

sentences.en: For example, because it's a popular place to visit, we spend a lot of time looking after the paths and making sure they're in good condition for walking
sentences.zh: 例如，由于这里是一个热门游览地，我们花大量时间维护步道，并确保它们处于良好的步行状态。

sentences.en: jan : I could certainly help with that
sentences.zh: jan : 这项工作我 certainly 可以帮忙。

sentences.en: peter : Good
sentences.zh: peter : 很好。

sentences.en: And we have a programme of creating new habitats there
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还在那里实施一项新建栖息地的计划。

sentences.en: We've just finished making and installing nesting boxes for birds to use, and next we're going to work on encouraging insects – they're important for the biodiversity of the reserve
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚完成并安装了一批供鸟类使用的巢箱；接下来我们将致力于吸引昆虫——它们对保护区的生物多样性至关重要。

sentences.en: jan : They certainly are
sentences.zh: jan : 的确如此。

sentences.en: peter : Oh, and we're also running a project to identify the different species of butterflies that visit the reserve
sentences.zh: peter : 哦，另外我们还在开展一项项目，旨在识别造访该保护区的不同蝴蝶种类。

sentences.en: You might be interested in taking part in that
sentences.zh: 您或许有兴趣参与这项工作。

sentences.en: jan : Sure
sentences.zh: jan : 当然可以。

sentences.en: I was involved in something similar where I used to live, counting all the species of moths
sentences.zh: 我以前住的地方就参与过类似项目，负责统计各种蛾类的种类。

sentences.en: I'd enjoy that
sentences.zh: 我很乐意做这件事。

sentences.en: peter : Another job we're doing at the reserve is replacing the wall on the southern side, between the parking area and our woodshed
sentences.zh: peter : 我们在保护区另一项正在进行的工作，是重建南侧围墙，即停车场与我们的木料棚之间的那段墙。

sentences.en: It was badly damaged in a storm last month
sentences.zh: 上个月一场暴风雨严重损坏了这堵墙。

sentences.en: jan : OK
sentences.zh: jan : 好的。

sentences.en: peter : Then as I said, we have a programme of events as well, both at the weekend, and during the week
sentences.zh: peter : 正如我刚才所说，我们还有系列主题活动，包括周末和工作日都会举办。

sentences.en: jan : Right
sentences.zh: jan : 明白了。

sentences.en: I presume you have guided walks?
sentences.zh: 我想你们应该有导览步行活动吧？

sentences.en: I'd like to get to know the local countryside, as I'm new to the area
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下当地的乡村，因为我刚搬到这个地区。

sentences.en: peter : Yes, we do
sentences.zh: peter: 是的，我们有。

sentences.en: The next walk is to Ruston Island, a week on Saturday
sentences.zh: 下一次徒步是去拉斯顿岛，下周六。

sentences.en: We'll be meeting in the car park at Dunsmore Beach at low tide – that's when the sands are dry enough for us to walk to the island without getting wet
sentences.zh: 我们将在邓斯莫尔海滩的停车场集合，时间是退潮时——那时沙滩足够干燥，我们可以步行到岛上而不会弄湿鞋子。

sentences.en: jan : Sounds good
sentences.zh: jan: 听起来不错。
